description: HWPXkit opens an HWPX file from a link or attachment, lists editable cells, paragraphs, LaTeX equations, and rows, then fills form blanks or applies text, run-formatting, and row edits. It returns a downloadable edited copy and supports a one-step rollback; the source file is never changed.
